description:
READ-ONLY: count the same things in both databases side by side and say, line by
    line, whether they match. This is the proof that a from-scratch migration carried
    everything - a load that reports 'ok' proves only that no exception was raised.

    `target_host`: the target database lives on ANOTHER server (a 19 -> 20 move always
    does - one Odoo major per box). Each side is then read on its own host.

    Besides counts it compares CONTENT that counts cannot show: survey/lesson/job titles,
    public link tokens, list:address pairs, file sizes and sha1 sums, empty files.
    Verdict per row: `tak` equal, `BRAK` target has LESS (data lost - never normal),
    `NADMIAR` target has more (usually Odoo's own defaults), `ROZNE` content differs.
name: data_compare
